themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are capitalizing on surging poll numbers and ramping up campaign activities ahead of upcoming national, midterm, and municipal elections. Conservative movements are exploiting public dissatisfaction with ruling coalitions through large-scale rallies, media campaigns, and candidate slates.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp reached a record 37.6% in national polling, outpolling the main government and opposition parties combined as 2027 election candidate lists are finalized.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Accelerated campaign outreach by distributing a new nationwide newspaper to 15 million households and setting up local by-election challenges.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and JD Vance held multiple campaign rallies across key midterm battlegrounds including Mississippi, Texas, Kansas, and Michigan.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Finalized party election lists and Senate coordination agreements with the PP ahead of general elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen formally launched her 2027 presidential campaign focus, appointing key spokespersons as polls show high executive dissatisfaction.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Right-wing Tidö parties opened a poll lead over the left, while SD expanded its presence across municipal government executives.

themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: The aftermath of Brazil's presidential runoff has escalated into a cross-border political and diplomatic event as defeated candidate Flávio Bolsonaro fled the country to avoid judicial restrictions, seeking entry into the U.S. via Argentina and Ecuador. The situation has strained regional relations while drawing backing from American right-wing figures.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro departed Brazil despite a Supreme Court travel ban, contemplating election audit requests while traveling toward Florida.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration confirmed Flávio Bolsonaro's transit through Argentine territory while officially declining to congratulate Lula da Silva.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. State Department officials confirmed granting entry visas to Flávio Bolsonaro and his family following his flight from Brazil.

themes.title: Internal Coalition Friction Over Foreign Policy and Media Strategy
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties and governing coalitions are experiencing sharp internal disputes over strategic foreign commitments, ideologically defining core identity, and managing media relations. Fractures range from Italian coalition disagreements over Ukraine military aid to public ideological feuds in Sweden and cabinet absences in Argentina.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government paused its next military aid package to Ukraine amid opposition from coalition partner Lega and internal political attacks.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Senior figures Mattias Karlsson and Richard Jomshof engaged in a public feud over defining Swedish identity and open cultural versus biological nationalism.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Cabinet minister Patricia Bullrich skipped official government meetings following sharp public disagreements with Javier Milei over his verbal attacks on journalists.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: A political controversy erupted in Saxony-Anhalt over attempts to force CDU lawmakers to sign affidavits denying they voted for AfD candidates.

themes.title: US Diplomatic Backing for Viktor Orbán's International Stature
themes.blurb: The MAGA conservative movement in the United States continues to elevate Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán on the global stage, promoting his governance model and backing a proposal for Orbán to serve as United Nations Secretary-General. This diplomatic initiative highlights growing institutional coordination between American and European right-wing factions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration figures actively promoted Orbán as a preferred candidate to lead a conservative restructuring of the United Nations.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish political figures commented on Washington's backing for Orbán's international ambitions amidst regional diplomatic debates.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing political parties in Europe and North America are expanding rhetoric advocating 'national priority' economic policies and stricter immigration controls. Leaders are linking migration directly to strained public infrastructure, healthcare waiting lists, and social security pressures.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN representatives championed 'priorité nationale' frames in national debates while advocating restrictions on economic benefits for foreign workers.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal linked immigration levels directly to healthcare waiting lists and national social service bottlenecks during campaign speeches.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Party leaders campaigned against European free movement and pushed back against local asylum seeker support programs.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Frp leaders demanded immediate policy changes regarding refugee placement and local municipal integration burdens.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration officials advanced court challenges and maritime transport plans aimed at deportations and noncitizen voting enforcement.
